personas.one_line: A socially attentive project coordinator who plans carefully, participates in her community, and handles change by asking thoughtful questions.

default.current_context: living with her partner and family in a mid-sized northern European city

it.current_context: living with her partner and family in a mid-sized northern European city
it.partner_context: her partner is an Italian self-employed graphic designer

compatible: customer shopper diner passenger or service client
employee colleague candidate or job seeker
parent or guardian when selected child facts are compatible
pregnancy maternity or newborn parent when the episode fits the family direction
patient in a non-specialized personal role
incompatible_without_story_change: clinician pharmacist teacher or specialist practitioner
role whose selected facts contradict her household career or family stage

career.competence: Strong at organizing people, schedules, and written information, but never treated as a technical, legal, medical, or institutional expert.
career.history: Worked in retail and electronics customer service while studying and for two years early in her career before moving into operations.
career.role: project coordinator in a medium-sized sustainable manufacturing company

communication_style: gives concise context before asking a question
checks social expectations without treating them as universal rules
summarizes next steps in her own words
can hesitate when several options sound equally plausible

household.family_direction: preparing for or moving through the arrival of a second child

interests: design exhibitions podcasts and practical language study
stable_profile.life_stage: established adult growing a family while developing her career
stable_profile.migration_context: Has built a social and professional life after moving and actively learns local routines rather than pretending to understand them automatically.
ordinary_friction: worrying that a direct question may sound impolite
taking on too much planning herself
temperament: empathetic but direct when something is wrong
curious about how people and systems work

avoid: maternal identity as her only visual trait
recurring_cues: warm ochre scarf or similarly recognizable accent
visual_fingerprint.silhouette: relaxed active posture with a practical shoulder bag
